title: Financial City
description: Shape a private monthly budget and watch traffic, civic services, construction pressure, and forty city blocks respond in a living miniature metropolis.

prompt.objective: Build a local-first budget planner whose miniature city reacts to financial health.

mintAssets.brief: A 25-piece Metropolitan Ledger city kit with civic, finance, resilience, and pressure districts.
A 19-piece traffic and infill kit with vehicles and three building-health tiers.

experience: Edit a monthly budget in-browser and derive private health metrics.
Drive traffic, building tiers, public services, and construction from those metrics.
prompt.visualDirection: Daylight architectural miniature in stone, glass, copper, and teal.

thumbnail.alt: A daytime miniature financial city with active streets, civic buildings, parks, and dense Metropolitan Ledger architecture.
